purpose: Detect host-specific presets across the complete checkout without rejecting portable platform defaults or measured evidence.

forbidden_categories.literal_user_path: A concrete user home or user-specific checkout path is not portable configuration.
forbidden_categories.literal_absolute_path: A concrete absolute system, volume, or UNC path is not portable configuration.
forbidden_categories.fixed_local_endpoint: A fixed loopback/private endpoint is not allowed as an outbound default.
forbidden_categories.ambient_proxy_read: Ambient HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy variables may not silently configure scholarly requests.
forbidden_categories.ambient_package_index_read: Ambient pip/uv index, trust, or config variables may not silently redirect dependency installation.
forbidden_categories.ambient_credential_read: Optional scholarly credentials may be read only from an explicit user-supplied environment/configuration; absence must retain the anonymous or credential_required path.
forbidden_categories.hardcoded_proxy_value: A proxy URL must come from explicit user configuration, never a source default.
forbidden_categories.private_network_endpoint: A concrete private-network endpoint is not a portable public-source default.
forbidden_categories.ambient_environment_inheritance: Passing the complete host environment to a child process is allowed only where the owner explicitly documents that user command environment is part of the protocol.
forbidden_categories.host_font_preset: A named workstation font can change figure/UI geometry; use a bundled or generic family, or an explicit venue template.
forbidden_categories.host_locale_inference: Locale/time-zone inference from the host must not silently change a research artifact or UI protocol.

allowlist.reason: Ignored runtime/evaluation evidence records measured host facts; they are not installed defaults or package source.
The optional console intentionally binds localhost and uses port 0 or a user-supplied port; it is not an outbound proxy.
Tests use deterministic local endpoints and proxy values only as explicit fixtures.

Scholar-service keys and contact email are optional user inputs. They are read only at request time, never defaulted or written to receipts, and absence keeps anonymous or credential_required behavior.
These executor/test paths preserve an explicitly supplied user command or isolated-test environment; scholarly network clients still use network_config_core and scrub ambient proxy variables.
The optional Codex bridge explicitly copies only the child environment after removing all ambient proxy variables; this is the documented user-command protocol.
The optional add-on's local Python/Codex preflight preserves ordinary user settings but explicitly removes proxy and package-index variables before each probe.
Documentation may show platform paths, venue font guidance, or locale terminology as examples; it is not executable configuration.
The policy explains the portable /usr/bin/env shebang allowance; this string is not runtime configuration.
These declarations contain repository-relative or ${PLUGIN_ROOT} paths, not host filesystem bindings.
/usr/bin/env is a standard portable shebang resolver, not a fixed runtime installation path.
Downloaded venue policies/templates are source evidence and may preserve their own LaTeX/font/path examples; they are never executed as Research Guard defaults.
These documents explain or preserve a historical transport example; the text explicitly says it is not a package default.
The CI migration test uses representative Windows system paths as explicit resolution fixtures.

portable_defaults.reason: Per-user fallback is portable when an explicit environment/CLI override is honored.
The current working directory is an invocation fallback, not a fixed checkout path.
Measured host facts are evidence/telemetry and must not be treated as entitlements or defaults.
The resource contract is an explicit project policy, not a guess about the current machine.
Repository ownership and publication identity are project metadata, not a user-home or credential preset.
Bundled or generic font families keep figure and optional-UI geometry portable across hosts.
Official direct access is the neutral route; regional mirrors and proxies require explicit user selection.
The optional UI has an explicit project-language default and does not infer the host locale.
